game.name: Cortex Commandos
game.desc:
What? A Crash Bandicoot arena shooter?!
Choose from 9 dastardly Crash Bandicoot villains and wreak havoc against a massive bandicoot-clone army! Upgrade your villain and wipe every bandicoot off the face of the earth! Test your mettle in story mode, arena mode and deathmatch mode and catch the thief who stole the master crystal and built the clone army!
